title: Vertex embedding map
statement: Given natural numbers $m,L$, a list $s$ of natural numbers, and a natural number $v$, map $v$ to the entry $s_v$ when $v<m$, using $0$ if that entry is unavailable; when $v\ge m$, map it to $L+(v-m)$.
